subject: Rundown & Scout: Redwood vs Nimbus — agreed tests and open questions
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moretti <alex.moretti@medsync.com>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay@medsync.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Rundown & Scout: Redwood vs Nimbus — agreed tests and open questions

Alex / Sanjay — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap from our side and a proposed set of follow-up tests so we can make the bakeoff concrete. I tried to keep this short and action-oriented.

Key pain points you called out
- Sporadic latency spikes during peak loads (especially around batch jobs starting at 02:00 UTC).
- Embedding inconsistency across model variants — search relevance sometimes drifts after retrain.
- Compliance: need proof of VPC separation, audit logs, and SOC2 artifacts before procurement sign-off.
- Cost: target is to get embeddings unit cost roughly 50% down vs current provider spend.

Goals we heard
- 95th percentile gen latency under ~200ms at your 8k-context target for the primary use-case.
- Embedding quality parity (top-5 retrieval overlap) on your 10k queries test set.
- A reproducible, automated soak run (72 hours) that we can hand to procurement/infra as evidence.

Decision criteria (what you said matters most)
1) Latency stability (p95 & p99 under steady and spike conditions)
2) Output quality (embedding parity + semantic drift checks)
3) Security & isolation (VPC, KMS, audit logs)
4) Cost / predictable unit economics
5) Support & runbook for failover/canary behavior

Open technical questions we need answered from both sides
- How does Redwood's KV/prefix cache behave with rolling updates? Is cold-start throughput acceptable for short-lived inference workers?
- Memory footprint at 8k context on an A100 vs H100 profile (rough numbers helpful).
- Exact quantization parity for INT8/FP16 variants and any known quality regressions.
- Can you provide a representative traffic replay harness (we can share our recorder if needed).

Proposed side-by-side tests (high level)
A) Latency soak (72h): run both vendors on your replayed traffic at 50rps average with 100rps spikes for 10m every hour — capture p50/p95/p99, tail latency events, and retry counts.
B) Embedding parity: run our embedding model vs your incumbent on the 10k labelled set — compute top-5 overlap and downstream retrieval metric (MRR@10).
C) Failover / canary: induce model variant rollouts and measure request loss/spike behavior (verify fallback to smaller variant).

Who does what (proposed)
- Redwood (Dylan / Marissa) to produce the test matrix, provide temporary API keys, and share a sample runner (Docker + scripts).
- MedSync (Alex / Sanjay) to provide the 10k queries + sample production logs and a test account or IP allowlist.
- Schedule: proposed kickoff Wed 24 Nov (10:00 PST) for test alignment and access exchange.

Attachments: I attached a draft test matrix (redwood-vs-nimbus-test-matrix.xlsx) outlining steps above + metrics to capture.

Next steps / ask
- Confirm the kickoff time (Wed 24 Nov 10:00 PST?) and who on your side will own provisioning.
- Sanjay / procurement: please confirm procurement timeline constraints (PO deadlines, review windows).

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call to clarify any point.

--
Dylan Brooks
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0151
https://redwoodinference.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Rundown & Scout: Redwood vs Nimbus — agreed tests and open questions

Dylan — thanks for the tidy recap. A couple of internal notes and one tweak for the external plan below.

Internal items
- Add a canary fallback resilience test (simulate a bad rollout that triggers the fallback policy) — this often surfaces regressions not caught in static replay.
- We should include a quantized INT8 run in parallel to verify quality delta; plan to run FP16 + INT8 at identical input distribution.
- Pricing ask: include an explicit cost-per-embed projection in the test matrix (projected 30/90/365 day spend). Helps procurement.

Jonas — can you estimate memory numbers for A100 vs H100 on an 8k context baseline? If you can drop a short table into the matrix I will include it in the kickoff.

Dylan — once Jonas and I align, I suggest we send a tightened test doc to Alex that lists exact commands for the 72h soak (so they can hand to infra).

--
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Alex Moretti <alex.moretti@medsync.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay@medsync.com>, procurement <procurement@medsync.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Nov 2026 13:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Rundown & Scout: Redwood vs Nimbus — agreed tests and open questions

Thanks Dylan (and team) — this is super helpful and clear. A few clarifications from our side: we can provide the 10k labelled set and a replay harness (we'll sanitize PII). Procurement timeline: we need signed results and an internal security review completed by Dec 15 to hit our Q4 launch commitments.

Couple of asks
- Please include a short regulatory checklist with VPC/KMS/retention policies — procurement needs that specifically.
- Can you include expected API keys and allowlist instructions in the kickoff email so our infra can pre-configure?
- On the latency soak: we want one extra scenario simulating large-batch ingest (300 concurrent streams for 2 minutes) to see how the system reacts to bursty telemetry ingest.

We'll aim to have an infra contact (Sanjay) in the kickoff meeting. If tests look good, procurement will move to draft PO and legal will request a short SOW.

Alex
VP Product | MedSync Health
alex.moretti@medsync.com | +1 (617) 555-0103

Subject: Re: Rundown & Scout: Redwood vs Nimbus — agreed tests and open questions

Appreciate the quick confirmations, Alex — good to see the timeline. Finalizing a few items before kickoff:

1) Kickoff: Wed 24 Nov, 10:00 PST — invite sent (Zoom). Agenda: access exchange, test matrix walk-through, responsibilities, logging/metrics schema.

2) Updated test matrix: attached (redwood-vs-nimbus-test-matrix.xlsx) — includes: 72h latency soak + burst scenario, embedding parity steps, canary/fallback runbook, and cost projection table. Jonas: added your notes on A100/H100 memory footprint (summary row).

3) Regulatory checklist: short doc included in Drive link (https://drive.redwood.com/s/medsync-test-matrix) — VPC architecture diagram + list of artifacts (SOC2 cert copy, audit log schema, KMS integration notes).

4) Access: we'll provision temporary API keys post-kickoff and provide an allowlist IP range (please confirm Sanjay's infra contact email if different).

5) Deliverables & timing: kickoff 11/24 -> test run 11/25–11/28 (72h window) -> results report by 11/30 -> procurement/PO decision target 12/15.

Attached files:
- redwood-vs-nimbus-test-matrix.xlsx (test steps, metrics, sample commands)
- medsync-sample-logs-20261118.txt (sanitized sample logs you provided during the call)

If that all looks good I'll lock the calendar and share the runner repo and credentials after kickoff.

Thanks all — looking forward to the run.

--
